sources.title: Office of the Prime Minister of Ethiopia

capital.evidence_quote: Addis Ababa is the constitutional capital and diplomatic headquarters of the African Union

currency.evidence_quote: The Ethiopian Birr (ETB, Br) is the legal tender currency governed by the National Bank of Ethiopia

timezone.evidence_quote: Ethiopia observes East Africa Time (UTC+3) throughout all national regional administrations

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic distribution voltage is 220V with frequency of 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National grid synchronized operating frequency is maintained uniformly at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Europlug Types C and F are standard, with Type G British sockets present in major international hotels

police.evidence_quote: Dial 991 nationwide for emergency federal and regional police assistance

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 907 (or 997 for Red Cross) for emergency medical ambulance coordination

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 939 for urban fire brigade dispatch and structural collapse emergency response

general.evidence_quote: Dial 911 in Addis Ababa for unified emergency response routing

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Yeniden Değerlendirin (Addis Ababa Sakin; Amhara ve Bölgesel Çatışma Alanları Riskli)
advisory_headline.en: Reconsider Travel (Addis Ababa Stable; Amhara & Border Conflict Regions High Risk)
advisory_headline.de: Reise überdenken (Addis Abeba stabil; Amhara und Grenzregionen mit hohem Sicherheitsrisiko)
advisory_headline.ru: Пересмотрите планы поездки (Аддис-Абеба стабильна; регионы конфликтов в Амхаре опасны)
advisory_headline.es: Reconsidere viajar (Adís Abeba estable; regiones de conflicto en Amhara de alto riesgo)

regional_warnings.area: Amhara region, Tigray border zones, Gambella border
regional_warnings.reason: Civil unrest, armed conflict, and roadside kidnappings

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Ethiopia shows median mobile cellular download speeds around 24.5 Mbps across Ethio Telecom and Safaricom 4G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Ethiopian fixed broadband median download benchmark registers approximately 19.8 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM cards require mandatory biometric and passport registration with Ethio Telecom or Safaricom Ethiopia; travel eSIMs active in Addis Ababa
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Strict SIM card registration with verified identity documentation enforced under ECA telecom laws

religion.evidence_quote: Census data documents Ethiopian Orthodox and Islamic communities forming the principal faiths

festivals.value: Timkat (Epiphany, Jan 19), Meskel (Finding of True Cross, Sept), Enkutatash (Ethiopian New Year, Sept 11), Genna (Christmas, Jan 7)
festivals.evidence_quote: Timkat and Meskel inscribed on UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list with massive national celebrations

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Remove shoes when entering churches and mosques; cover shoulders and knees in religious sites; fasting seasons mean widespread vegan (tsom) dining; respect local calendar (7-8 years behind Gregorian)
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Traditional church etiquette demands shoe removal and reverent conduct throughout sacred precincts

tipping.value: Customary in hospitality; 10% in sit-down restaurants in Addis Ababa; tipping guides and drivers (5-10 USD per day) is customary on excursions
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is widely practiced and deeply appreciated by hospitality and tour operating personnel
